maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail: A miner lies slumped against the tunnel wall. His breathing is shallow, but he's still alive.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-10: The cavern opens into a vast chamber. At its center stands a humanoid figure made entirely of crystal, surrounded by floating violet shards.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-11: The tile at (22, -46) activates when the party steps on it or an object holds it down.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-12: A faint smell of copper attracts you to a narrow side chamber. The body of a miner lies limp against the wall, with hands blackened from gripping rocks. Between the stiff fingers, there is a piece of paper torn and stained with dirt.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-13: The tile at (-1, -61) activates when the party steps on it or an object holds it down.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-14: Step on the sensor at (-1, -61) (can also be pressed by objects), and continue the events in the second mining chamber.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-2: The tile at (3, -42) activates when the party steps on it or an object holds it down.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-4: The crystal entity fractures with a sharp crack, its light fading into the stone.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-5: Defeat “The Shattered” (25, -46), You need to defeat the enemies (Cursed Digger, Infected Miner)
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-6: The crystal entity shatters at last, its fractured light fading.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-7: Defeat “The Shattered” (25, -46), There must still be enemies alive (Cursed Digger, Infected Miner)
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-8: The tunnel widens into a large chamber. Shards of broken lanterns lie scattered in the dust. Eyes gleam in the darkness ahead. Wolves step forward, crimson veins pulsing beneath their fur.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.detail-9: The tile at (0, -51) activates when the party steps on it or an object holds it down.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue: He slowly raises his head. Black veins spread across his pale face, and his eyes glow faintly red in the torchlight.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-11: Whatever has corrupted him, it has not brought him back from the dead.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-12: The man is still alive, trapped inside a horribly twisted body.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-13: Choose “Those veins... let me see what kind of bloodcraft this is.”
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-14: You examine the black veins spreading beneath the miner's skin. His blood is still flowing, but something has changed it.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-15: You recognize no blood magic capable of causing such a transformation.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-16: This is no disciplined blood rite. The power feels closer to the void than to fleshcraft, warped into something violent and unstable.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-18: You don't hesitate. The moment it moves, your arrow is already in flight.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-19: The arrow strikes deep, punching through corrupted flesh. The creature staggers, its body jerking as blackened blood spills across the stone.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-20: It does not fall. Whatever keeps it alive refuses to let go.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-21: The unnatural pulse that filled the tunnels finally stops.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-22: At last, the mine is quiet.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-23: The miners slump against the stone, breathing hard. For a moment, it seems they might live.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-25: Their bodies seize, veins blackened by the crystal's corruption. One by one, they crumple beside the shattered shards.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-27: The mine falls silent once more.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-28: The cavern opens into a vast chamber. At its center stands a humanoid figure made entirely of crystal, surrounded by floating violet shards.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-29: The shards spin faster, sending fragments of rock falling from the ceiling. Behind you, the stone walls grind shut, blocking your escape.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-3: His plea turns into a snarl. His jaw opens unnaturally wide, and he lunges toward you.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-30: Two infected miners emerge from the darkness. Their skin is cracked, their eyes vacant.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-31: The crystal figure begins to move. Its shards spin faster as it turns toward you.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-5: "Let me see what still lives in him." (Requires Paladin)
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-6: "Those veins... let me see what kind of bloodcraft this is." (Requires Blood Mage)
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-8: Choose “Let me see what still lives in him.”
maps.points.forgotten_vein.dialogue-9: You reach beyond flesh, searching for the familiar stain of undeath.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.f16.detail: Step on the sensor at (0, -51) (can also be pressed by objects) to continue the events of the first mine chamber.
maps.points.forgotten_vein.f22.detail: Step on the sensor at (22, -46) (can also be pressed by objects) to continue the events of the living crystal mine chamber.

maps.points.forgotten_vein.title-4: Destroy the crystal; the miner survives
